title: Kids Phone – Rechargeable Toy for Kids with 24 Learning Modes | Talking Dummy Mobile for Boys & Girls Age 2–12 | Educational Mobile Phone Toy with, Music & Games Flash Card
bullets: 24 INTERACTIVE LEARNING MODES: Explore music, stories, animals, fruits, colours, numbers, body parts, transport and nature sounds. The kids learning phone supports listening, vocabulary, recognition and independent play.

RECHARGEABLE TYPE-C DESIGN: The built-in 150mAh battery charges in about 30 minutes and provides up to 3–4 hours of play, depending on use. No repeated battery replacement is needed for everyday or travel play.

MUSIC, FLASH CARD GAMES & PRETEND PLAY: Voice prompts, light effects, musical sounds and flash card activities keep children engaged. The smartphone-style body and pretend dual-camera design encourage imaginative role play.

EASY CONTROLS FOR CHILDREN: Simple buttons, adjustable volume and lock/unlock functions make the toy easy to operate. Its compact shape is comfortable for small hands and convenient for car rides, flights and family visits.

GIFT FOR BOYS AND GIRLS AGES 2–12: A practical birthday, festive or return-gift choice for children who enjoy electronic learning toys. Smooth ABS construction and rounded edges support comfortable handling. Do not use while charging.
